chunks: And it was narrated from Zurārah, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man buys the owned slave along with his wealth. He said, ‘There is no harm.’ I said: Then the wealth of the owned slave may be greater than that for which he purchased him? He said, ‘There is no harm.’

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.زُرَارَةَ: Zurārah, the narrator reporting the hadith
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy a slave together with the slave’s wealth, even if that wealth is worth more than the sale price?
ai.summary: This hadith states that purchasing a slave together with the slave’s property is permissible. It further clarifies that there is no problem even if the slave’s wealth exceeds the purchase price, indicating permissibility in this form of sale.
